items.title: 2.12.1 Using dy to Approximate Δy (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Book p. 60-61: 2.12.1 Using dy to Approximate Δy, Fig. 2.7 and the box Using Differentials to Approximate

blocks.text: Pichle sabaq mein humne \(dy = f'(x)\,dx\) define kiya. Ab asal sawal: is \(dy\) ka faida kya hai? Jawab: \(dy\) humein function ki asal tabdeeli \(\Delta y\) ka bohat acha andaza deta hai, aur woh bhi aasaan hisaab se. Aaiye dekhte hain kaise.

Jab function \(y = f(x)\) point \(P(x, y)\) par differentiable ho, to \(x\) mein chhoti si tabdeeli \(\Delta x\) (delta x, yani \(x\) mein farq) ke liye hum differential \(dy\) se \(y\) ki asal tabdeeli \(\Delta y\) ka andaza laga sakte hain.
\(y\) mein asal tabdeeli \(\Delta y\) yeh hai: nayi value minus purani value,

blocks.text_alt: delta y equals f of (x plus delta x) minus f of x, equation (1)

blocks.text:
Lekin \(\Delta y\) ko bilkul theek theek nikalna aksar mushkil formulas maangta hai, jaise \((1.1)^{3}\) ya \(\sqrt{24}\). Is ke bajaye hum differential \(dy\) use karte hain, jo yun define hai:
\[dy = f'(x)\,dx\]
Agar hum \(dx = \Delta x\) le lein (dono ek hi qadam), to:

blocks.text_alt: d y equals f prime of x times delta x, equation (2)

blocks.text: Ab curve \(y = f(x)\) par \(P(x, y)\) ke qareeb ek doosra point \(Q(x + \Delta x, f(x + \Delta x))\) lijiye.

items: \(P\) par tangent line ka slope \(f'(x)\) hai (derivative ka matlab hi yeh hai).
\(P\) aur \(Q\) ko jorne wali secant line (do points se guzarne wali line) ka slope \(\frac{\Delta y}{\Delta x}\) hai, yani rise over run.

blocks.text: Jab \(\Delta x \to 0\) (yani \(\Delta x\) chhota hota jata hai), point \(Q\) point \(P\) ki taraf aata hai, aur secant line \(PQ\) dheere dheere \(P\) par tangent line ban jati hai. Fig. 2.7 mein teeno tasveeron ko baayen se daayen dekhiye: \(\Delta x\) chhota hota ja raha hai aur hari (green) secant line narangi (orange) tangent line par letti ja rahi hai.

blocks.alt: Halki peeli panel par saath saath teen chhote graph. Har ek mein ek charhti curve, us par fixed point P, doosra point Q, P aur Q se guzarti hari secant line, P par narangi tangent line, aur x-axis ke neeche Delta x ka faasla. Pehle graph mein points P(x, y) aur Q(x + Delta x, f(x + Delta x)) likhe hain. Baayen se daayen Delta x chhota hota hai aur secant tangent ke qareeb aati jati hai; teesri curve kaali hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.7: Δx chhota hone par Q, P ki taraf aata hai aur secant PQ, P par tangent ke qareeb aa jati hai (textbook ki figure ke mutabiq original drawing)

blocks.text:
Is liye chhote \(\Delta x\) ke liye:
\(P\) par tangent line ka slope \(\approx\) secant line \(PQ\) ka slope
\[\Rightarrow f'(x) \approx \dfrac{\Delta y}{\Delta x}\]
Ab \(f'(x) \approx \frac{\Delta y}{\Delta x}\) ko equation (2) mein rakhein:
\[dy \approx \dfrac{\Delta y}{\Delta x} \times \Delta x\]
\[dy \approx \Delta y \quad (\text{for } \Delta x \text{ is small})\]
Dekhiye kya hua: \(\Delta x\) upar neeche cancel ho gaya. Yani chhoti tabdeeli \(\Delta x\) ke liye asal tabdeeli \(\Delta y\) takreeban differential \(dy\) ke barabar hai:

blocks.text_alt: delta y is approximately equal to d y, which equals f prime of x times d x

blocks.text: Is derivation ko ek baar apne alfaaz mein dohra lete hain. Pehle humne asal tabdeeli \(\Delta y\) likhi. Phir aasaan tabdeeli \(dy\) likhi jo tangent line deti hai. Phir figure se dekha ke chhote qadam par secant aur tangent ka slope takreeban ek jaisa hai. Is ek baat ne dono tabdeeliyon ko jor diya: \(dy \approx \Delta y\). Yaad rakhiye, poori baat "chhote \(\Delta x\)" ki shart par khari hai.

Kyun ke \(\Delta y = f(x + \Delta x) - f(x)\), aur chhoti tabdeeli \(\Delta x\) ke liye \(dx = \Delta x\) aur \(\Delta y \approx dy\).
\(\Rightarrow dy \approx f(x + \Delta x) - f(x)\)
aur is liye: \(f(x + \Delta x) \approx f(x) + dy\)
blocks.title: Using Differentials to Approximate:

blocks.text:
Do alag tabdeeliyan hain, inhein mila na dein:
\(\Delta y\) = curve ka asal uthna, \(x\) se \(x + \Delta x\) tak (bilkul sahi, lekin nikalna mushkil ho sakta hai).
\(dy\) = usi qadam par tangent line ka uthna (aasaan: slope ganna qadam).
Chhote qadam par curve aur tangent mushkil se alag hote hain, is liye \(\Delta y \approx dy\).
Misaal: pahaari sarak par aap ek chhota qadam lein to aap ki unchaai utni hi badalti hai jitni sarak ke us jagah ke dhalwaan (slope) ke hisaab se badalni chahiye. Lekin 1 km aage jayen to sarak mur chuki hogi aur yeh andaza kaam nahi karega.
blocks.title: Teaching note

blocks.text:
Box ki aakhri line, \(f(x + \Delta x) \approx f(x) + dy = f(x) + f'(x)\,\Delta x\), bilkul wahi idea hai jo 2.11.1 mein linearization ka tha: \(L(x) = f(a) + f'(a)(x - a)\) mein \(a\) ki jagah \(x\), aur \(x\) ki jagah \(x + \Delta x\) rakh dein.
"Use differentials to approximate \(\sqrt{24}\)" jaise sawalon ka yahi working formula hai: maloom value \(f(x)\) jama chhota sa correction \(dy\).
blocks.title: Teaching note

blocks.text:
\(f(x) = x^{2}\), \(x = 3\), \(\Delta x = 0.1\).
Asal tabdeeli: \(\Delta y = (3.1)^{2} - 3^{2} = 9.61 - 9 = 0.61\).
Differential: \(dy = 2x\,dx = 2(3)(0.1) = 0.6\).
Farq sirf 0.01 hai, jo \((\Delta x)^{2}\) hai. \(\Delta x\) aur chhota karein to farq aur bhi tezi se chhota hota hai.
blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal

blocks.text:
Agar \(x\) kam ho raha ho, maslan 5 se 4.9, to \(\Delta x\) kya hoga?
(Jawab: \(\Delta x = 4.9 - 5 = -0.1\). Negative! Hamesha "nayi value minus purani value" lein.)
blocks.title: Khud sochiye

blocks.text:
1. Asal tabdeeli: \(\Delta y = f(x + \Delta x) - f(x)\).
2. Differential: \(dy = f'(x)\,dx\), jahan \(dx = \Delta x\).
3. \(\Delta x \to 0\) par secant \(PQ\) tangent ban jati hai, is liye chhote \(\Delta x\) ke liye \(\Delta y \approx dy\).
4. Andaze ka formula: \(f(x + \Delta x) \approx f(x) + f'(x)\,\Delta x\).
blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein

blocks.text:
1. \(\Delta y = dy\) ko bilkul barabar likhna; yeh sirf \(\approx\) hai.
2. Bara \(\Delta x\) le kar yeh rule lagana: tab secant tangent se door hoti hai aur andaza kamzor aata hai.
3. \(dx\) ka sign ghalat lena: agar \(x\) kam ho raha hai to \(\Delta x\) negative hai.
